newsitem.title: UK: Greenway Holdings in PowerGen deal.
newsitem.headline: Greenway Holdings in PowerGen deal.

text.p: Waste oil recycler Greenway Holdings Plc said on Wednesday it signed a contract with electricity generator PowerGen Plc to supply recycled support fuel to one of that company's power stations.
"The directors believe that this contract substantially addresses the volume problems affecting Greenway over the last 18 months," Greenway said in a statement.
It added that it expected benefits from the deal to begin to accrue in the second half of the current financial year.
The agreement covered a three-year term and provided for the supply of a minimum volume of fuel per month at agreed prices, the company said.
